fullDescription: Default user-profile-overview view for OnderCampos with profile details, interactive profile navigation, pinned public repositories, achievements, and contribution activity. It accepts a serializable state prop defaulting to default and composes the shared dashboard header, repository cards, and contribution graph.
Reusable dark application header with GitHub branding, configurable username, search field, account control, and interactive utility controls that expose pressed states.

Reusable repository collection card accepting a title, repository metadata items, and initial star state. Each card renders repository descriptions, language and star metadata, and an interactive star control.
Reusable compact public repository card accepting repository name, optional fork and description metadata, and a language label for profile pin collections.
Reusable annual contribution heatmap accepting a contribution count and providing accessible contribution cells with a locally interactive selected-year control.
